scope: Bind imported DXF point-cloud definition/reactor typed callbacks to their complete raw OBJECTS carriers and actual physical scalar spans, without admitting imported graph output.

behavior: A separate optional source facet leaves the established DRW_Interface vtable unchanged and is selected only for the concrete adapter's tracked DXF source capture.
The parser publishes the typed point-cloud definition, raw carrier, physical capture status, and immutable physical-span owner only after accepting the next OBJECTS code-0 boundary.

The adapter retains bounded private typed/raw snapshots, container generation and identity, source version, encoding, and the physical-span owner; later graph preparation checks typed callback pairing, record identity, exact field-code order, span bounds, and unchanged typed state.

DXF ACAD_REACTORS appData is normalized into the typed reactor handle list only when one complete reactor group exactly matches that parsed list; the raw source carrier remains available as provenance.

Imported DXF graph output stays refused pending POINTCLOUDEX entity source-field binding and a complete source-to-writer field projection. DWG remains refused pending source CLASS/frame/output binding.

validationProfile.source: Locally generated in-memory low-level DXF records; no fixture files were added.
assertions: The source facet reports a complete physical capture with the expected source revision and encoding.
Every non-comment raw group has the same ordered group code as its physical source span, and each span has a positive in-order boundary.
The raw carrier name and typed kind match the parsed point-cloud callback.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 2/2; generated source-span controls cover ASCII/Binary and nested reactor group fields, and the existing authored graph adapter control remains passing.

limitations: Source-span transport does not prove that every raw point-cloud field has a writer projection.
POINTCLOUDEX entity carriers, imported graph output, physical producer breadth, DWG source CLASS/frame binding, asset loading, and native consumer semantics remain open.
